Maya: Quick question  - corpcard declined at SFO taxi stand so I withdrew cash (ATM) and paid driver. Cash receipt attached (photo). ATM fee $3.50, taxi $28.00. Trip date 2026-05-03.
Tom - Manager: Approved for reimbursement. Sorry that happened.
Priya - Finance: Thanks Maya. For ATM + taxi, submit two line items in Concur: taxi (expense code TR_TAXI) and bank ATM fee (OTHER_BANK_FEE). Need photo of taxi receipt + ATM bank slip or screenshot of withdrawal from bank app. If ATM slip missing, a bank statement line is acceptable.
Maya: Uploaded taxi_pic.jpg and mobile_bank_txn.png to Concur ID EXP-2026-0503-2211. Note says "card decline at taxi stand, personal cash used."
CardOpsBot: Created ticket CORP-CARD-11321 for issuer decline investigation. Please include merchant name/terminal info if available.
Priya - Finance: Got it. We'll queue for expedited pay run. FYI if CardOps finds a charge later that posts to corpcard we'll reconcile and reverse the ATM fee reimbursement.
ExpenseBot: Expense EXP-2026-0503-2211 submitted by Maya at 2026-05-04 09:03 UTC. Status: awaiting finance processing.
Tom - Manager: Thanks everyone. Maya, could you ping CardOps if you get any follow-up from your bank?
Maya: Will do, thx. :thumbsup:
